writeup: TIC 258490713 is a candidate eclipsing binary star with an orbital period of 4.2400 days. Automated analysis of TESS photometry detected a primary eclipse causing 7.30% dimming, with a strong signal-to-noise ratio of 89.5. Pixel-level imaging confirmed the signal at the target location, though with a centroid offset of 0.9 arcsec. No secondary eclipse was detected. The system does not appear in six major variable-star catalogs, making it a potentially new find. The pipeline's machine-learning model assigned this candidate a score of 0.24, indicating moderate likelihood of being a genuine target. All automated data quality checks passed without flags.
